recovery.postingTitle: The job posting you bought this analysis for
recovery.postingNote: Your purchase was made with a job posting. Paste it here and the analysis is measured against it. You can leave this empty.

clipped.posting: The job posting was longer than {{max}} characters, so this analysis read its first {{max}}.
clipped.linkedIn: Your LinkedIn text was longer than {{max}} characters, so this analysis read its first {{max}}.

paidAnalysis.inProgress: Your analysis is already being made. This page shows it as soon as it is ready.
paidAnalysis.busy: The analysis service is busy right now, so nothing was made and nothing was saved. Your purchase is safe and still unused: try again in a few minutes.

refused.title: This purchase cannot open an analysis
refused.refunded: This purchase was refunded, so it no longer includes an analysis. If you did not expect that, write to {{email}} from the address you paid with.
refused.notThisProduct: This purchase was not for a Full Resume Analysis, so it cannot open one here. Open it from the link in its own purchase email.
refused.notFound: We could not find this purchase. Open your analysis from the link in your purchase email, and if this page still says this, write to {{email}} from the address you paid with.
refused.used: This purchase has already made its analysis, and each purchase makes one. Open it from the link in your purchase email or from the order in your account.
refused.grant: Your Pro membership cannot include this analysis right now: the membership is not active, its payment was refunded, or this link is from before an update. Sign in and open the Full Analysis again from your account.
refused.cap: Pro includes up to 10 Full Analyses a day and 60 a month, and this account has reached one of those limits, so nothing was made and nothing was spent. Open it again from the same link tomorrow; if you have opened 60 in the last 30 days, it opens once that count falls.

pdf.device: This device's browser could not draw the PDF: the analysis is larger than it can draw. Open this page on a computer to save it, or use your browser's Print to save it as a PDF.

sectionsMissing.jobDescription: This analysis could not compare your résumé with the job posting this time, so that part is left out. Everything else in the analysis is complete.
sectionsMissing.linkedIn: This analysis could not review your LinkedIn profile this time, so that part is left out. Everything else in the analysis is complete.

page.emailSentBody: A copy was sent to your email
page.deleteConfirmBody: This action cannot be undone. Your resume analysis will be permanently deleted from our servers. This helps ensure your privacy under GDPR and CCPA regulations.
